_comment: Used by Electron to run a KISS app as a desktop application. PREREQUISITE: run './bld build' first to produce the backend (tomcat/ + work/exploded). A system or bundled JRE 17+ is required at launch because the shell spawns './bld start-backend'. 'npm run pack' / 'npm run dist' package this shell with electron-builder; bundling a self-contained JRE is out of scope.
